text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Power is surging... My legs are itching to 
run!? Th-This kind of change wasn't in my 
production plan!?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Could this be... the Three Goddesses 
personally producing me!?!?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"...I can't just sit around! How should I 
make the most of this power...? I need to 
come up with a brand-new plan right away!"
